law.catch_line: Initiation by Department of Social Services of support proceeding under convention

text.section:
In a support proceeding under this chapter, the Department of Social Services of the Commonwealth shall:
Transmit and receive applications; and
Initiate or facilitate the institution of a proceeding regarding an application in a tribunal of the Commonwealth.

The following support proceedings are available under the Convention to an obligor against which there is an existing support order:
Recognition of an order suspending or limiting enforcement of an existing support order of a tribunal of the Commonwealth;
Modification of a support order of a tribunal of the Commonwealth; and
Modification of a support order of a tribunal of another state or a foreign country.
A tribunal of the Commonwealth may not require security, bond, or deposit, however described, to guarantee the payment of costs and expenses in proceedings under the Convention.
